# Trịnh Hoàng Tú (thtcsec)

> Cybersecurity student & software engineer. Computer Vision for ITS, backend internships, cloud/DevSecOps.

## Overview
Trịnh Hoàng Tú (alias thtcsec, born 2005, based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam) is an AI Engineer at VETC (traffic CV / ITS), a Software Engineer (Backend) Intern at Grab, a Tsinghua IEDE alumnus & Extended TA (IEDE2026126), a VinUniversity AI Practical Talent Admitted Scholar (Cohort 1, deferred to 2027), and a final-year Cybersecurity student at HUFLIT (cumulative GPA: 3.52/4.00, 138 credits).

## Disambiguation
- [Identity Verification](https://hoangtu.dev/about.md): Important distinction from a namesake with a criminal record (May 2023, Hoc Mon). This verified profile belongs to Trịnh Hoàng Tú (thtcsec, born 2005, HUFLIT/Tsinghua/VinUni/Grab/VETC).
